# Emanuele Bartolesi

> Emanuele Bartolesi is a GitHub Technical Lead, a twelve-time Microsoft MVP, and a four-time GitHub Star (GitHub Star of the Year 2023), based in Zurich, Switzerland. He builds SaaS products on .NET and Azure, writes about software and AI-assisted development, speaks at conferences, and mentors developers.

Speaking invitations and general messages: https://www.emanuelebartolesi.com/contact

## Products and work

- [Products](https://www.emanuelebartolesi.com/products): the SaaS products he is building, with status, stack, and source links
- [Portfolio](https://www.emanuelebartolesi.com/portfolio): VS Code extensions and open-source projects
- [The Million Journey](https://www.emanuelebartolesi.com/millionjourney): public progress towards one million in revenue

## Writing and resources

- [Writing](https://www.emanuelebartolesi.com/blog): articles on .NET, GitHub, AI coding tools, and building products

- [GitHub Copilot guide](https://www.emanuelebartolesi.com/resources/github-copilot)
